coverage_notes: P0303’s existing anchor includes the stated unused-fee return duty; no additional clause is needed. Agreement termination, automatic severance, and the agreement to re-agree affected content in P0305 do not map faithfully to an allowed activity. P0309’s general continuation of rights and obligations does not identify a specific allowed activity.

paragraph_audit.reason: The existing anchor covers the conditional security-related service cessation and the return of any remaining fees if service is terminated.
Automatic severance and agreement termination are agreement-level effects, and re-agreeing affected content is a negotiation duty; none maps faithfully to an allowed activity.
The duty to continue exercising rights and performing obligations outside the dispute identifies no specific action representable by an allowed activity.
